project_info.theme: One-to-one personalized study abroad dossier and visa interview guidance
project_info.color_palette: White, French Blue, Red, Soft Gray, Skin Tones

main_subject.detail: A real consultation scene shows two women sitting across a white table, one advisor with a laptop and one student listening, while a television screen behind them displays a UNI-GATE Gen 8 France study poster.
main_subject.style: Photoreal office consultation poster with overlaid promotional text, soft natural indoor light, and branded educational event framing.

Centerpiece is a real one-to-one consultation scene with an advisor and student seated across a table, while a TV behind them displays a Uni-Gate France study slide. Background is a clean indoor office setting. Surrounding elements: VFE logo, top-right header 'DU HỌC PHÁP HƯỚNG ĐI MỚI SAU TỐT NGHIỆP 2026', large red label 'HỒ SƠ CÁ NHÂN HOÁ 1-1', notebook-style text 'Hướng dẫn chọn trường, ngành và luyện phỏng vấn xin visa', and on-screen CTA 'ĐĂNG KÝ NGAY'. Technical style: photoreal consultation marketing poster, soft indoor daylight, clean educational conversion overlays, 8k resolution, highly detailed.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: This is a real-service credibility creative. Keep the office setting and authentic human interaction. The date 'tháng 09/2026' on the TV slide is in the future relative to Friday, July 17, 2026, so preserve it as a forward-looking intake claim.
